# Workflows

- `ci.yml`: pull-request/main lint, full provider-free tests, clean four-target build, default-closed five-package verification, and forbidden-material checks.
- `qualify-npm-runtime.yml`: main-only manual qualification after checked Dream business, four-host, redistribution, and publication gates are all true; uploads exactly five verified tarballs plus aggregate checksums.
- `publish-npm.yml`: validates a successful same-SHA qualification run and npm bootstrap confirmation, re-verifies the immutable five-package set, then publishes four platform packages before the selector using OIDC.

Only the publish job receives `id-token: write`. Qualification and publication fail closed unless the checked receipt digest, all four target qualifications, and npm authorization remain exact.
